description.en: The trust policy of the RAM role.

description.zh:
RAM角色描述。

长度为1~1024个字符。
description.en:
The new description of the RAM role.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters long.

description.zh:
RAM角色最大会话时间。

取值范围：3600秒~43200秒。默认值：3600秒。
description.en:
The maximum session duration of the RAM role, in seconds.

Valid values: 3600 to 43200. The default value is 3600.

description.zh:
RAM角色名称。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the RAM role.

The name must be 1 to 64 characters long and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-).

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，更新RAM角色`ECSAdmin`的描述信息为`ECS管理员`。
descriptions.en: This example shows how to update the description of the RAM role `ECSAdmin` to `ECS management role`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram update-role --role-name ECSAdmin --new-assume-role-policy-document Statement_:_Action_:_sts:AssumeRole_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Principal_:_RAM_:_acs:ram::123456789012340000:root_,_Version_:_1 --new-max-session-duration 3600 --new-description ECS_management_role --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram UpdateRole --region cn-hangzhou --NewAssumeRolePolicyDocument 'Statement_:_Action_:_sts:AssumeRole_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Principal_:_RAM_:_acs:ram::123456789012340000:root_,_Version_:_1' --RoleName ECSAdmin --NewDescription ECS_management_role --NewMaxSessionDuration 3600
